scripts.postbuild: node -e "for (const f of ['.env', '.env.production']) require('node:fs').rmSync('.next/standalone/' + f, { force: true })" && node scripts/compile-hints.mjs && node scripts/check-has.mjs
scripts.test:tz: for tz in UTC Asia/Tehran America/Los_Angeles; do TZ=$tz vitest run --project unit src/lib/jalali.test.ts src/lib/hoursState.test.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.ci:local: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && node scripts/check-bidi.mjs && npm test && npm run test:tz && npm run build && node scripts/check-no-prerender.mjs && npm run db:e2e && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:bundle && npm run lhci
scripts.db:live: rm -f .data/e2e-live.db .data/e2e-live.db-wal .data/e2e-live.db-shm && mkdir -p .data && DATABASE_URL=file:./.data/e2e-live.db DB_PUSH=false node scripts/payload.mjs migrate && DATABASE_URL=file:./.data/e2e-live.db DB_PUSH=false node scripts/payload.mjs run src/seed/index.ts | tee .data/live-seed.log && (grep -q 'seed: mode' .data/live-seed.log || (echo 'db:live: the seeder printed no summary line, so .data/e2e-live.db is not seeded; read .data/live-seed.log' >&2 && exit 1))
scripts.db:e2e: rm -f .data/e2e.db .data/e2e.db-wal .data/e2e.db-shm && mkdir -p .data && DATABASE_URL=file:./.data/e2e.db DB_PUSH=false node scripts/payload.mjs migrate && DATABASE_URL=file:./.data/e2e.db DB_PUSH=false node scripts/payload.mjs run src/seed/index.ts | tee .data/seed.log && (grep -q 'seed: mode' .data/seed.log || (echo 'db:e2e: the seeder printed no summary line, so .data/e2e.db is not seeded; read .data/seed.log' >&2 && exit 1)) && DATABASE_URL=file:./.data/e2e.db DB_PUSH=false node scripts/payload.mjs run tests/fixtures/qa-seed.ts | tee .data/qa-fixture.log && (grep -q 'qa-fixture: dentist' .data/qa-fixture.log || (echo 'db:e2e: the QA fixture printed no summary line; read .data/qa-fixture.log' >&2 && exit 1))
